items.name: search-input
items.title: SearchInput
items.description: Standardised search box with leading icon, optional spinner, clear button, and a keyboard-shortcut hint slot. Pure UI — pair with `use-debounced-query` or your own state for the fetch.

items.name: sort-dropdown
items.title: SortDropdown
items.description: Reusable sort selector that pairs cleanly with useTableState — pick a field + flip direction. Active field label + directional arrow render in the trigger.

items.name: build-prisma-where
items.title: buildPrismaWhere + buildPrismaOrderBy
items.description: Convert a typed useTableState query object (q + filters) into a Prisma `where` clause. Supports `in`, `eq`, `bool`, `dateRange`, `numRange` filter kinds plus OR-search across multiple fields. Companion `buildPrismaOrderBy` for sort.

items.name: use-filters
items.title: useFilters (typed URL-synced filters)
items.description: Typed-schema filter state manager backed by URL params. Supports multi-select, bool, single-select, date range, number range. Provides set / toggle / clear / reset / isActive / activeCount.

items.name: global-search
items.title: GlobalSearch (⌘K multi-entity)
items.description: Cmd+K palette with live multi-entity search. Debounced query, grouped results by entity, recent items in localStorage, optional custom onSelect. Global ⌘K binding via useKeyboardShortcuts.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: FilterBar (composable faceted filters)
items.description: Composable faceted filter bar that reads/writes through `useFilters`. Compound exports — `FilterBar.Multi`, `FilterBar.Single`, `FilterBar.Bool`, `FilterBar.DateRange`, `FilterBar.NumRange` — plus a Clear-all chip when any filter is active.

items.name: recently-viewed
items.title: RecentlyViewed + useRecentlyViewedRecorder
items.description: Cross-entity 'recently viewed' panel backed by localStorage. `useRecentlyViewedRecorder()` records views from any page; `<RecentlyViewed>` renders the list with custom icon slot, type filter, remove + clear. Survives reloads, dedupes by type:id, capped at 20 entries.

items.name: saved-views
items.title: SavedViews (named filter+sort+columns combos)
items.description: User-saved views — name + URL query string per page key, with create / rename / delete / set-default. Composes for free with `useTableState`, `useFilters`, `useColumnPreferences` because everything is already URL-driven. Pair with a `SavedView` Prisma table keyed by (ownerId, viewKey).

items.name: quick-filters
items.title: QuickFilters (preset chips)
items.description: Preset filter chips above a list (All / Open / High priority / Stale > 7d). Different from `FilterBar` (every facet) and `SavedViews` (user-defined) — these are the *predefined* segments that come with the page. Optional `counts` prop renders server-supplied numeric badges per segment.
